samples.summary: Demoting every non-floor web font to a warn-only "quiet" wait removes the gate from families the baselines actually paint, and re-opens `visual:update` to recording fallback glyphs for them
samples.evidence: The delta narrows the hard gate to REQUIRED_WEB_FONTS (Inter/Fraunces/JetBrains Mono, verify-visual-browser.mjs:374-378); everything else only gets a 3s non-gating quiet check that `console.warn`s and returns success (verify-visual-browser.mjs:540-548), so `webFontFailures` stays empty and the `updateBaseline` refusal at verify-visual-browser.mjs:707 never fires. But captured targets do paint non-floor Google families: the `slides-pickers` baseline renders each SYSTEM row in its own family — `Roboto` and `Lora` are Google web fonts, not system faces (packages/frontend/src/app/slides/themed-font-picker-helpers.ts:16-17, rendered via style={{fontFamily: family}} at packages/frontend/src/app/slides/themed-font-picker.tsx:117), and `slides-theme-panel` renders each thumbnail's `theme.fonts.heading` (packages/frontend/src/app/slides/theme-thumbnail.tsx:44) where themes name Lora/Roboto/Poppins/Montserrat (packages/slides/src/themes/focus.ts:20, material.ts:20). Whenever any path registers those faces during a pass (a bootstrap link from `ensureGoogleFontsLink`, or a per-family link from `ensureFontLink`), the previous registry-derived wait gated them and this one does not — exactly the Inter-drift class of flake the PR exists to fix, now downgraded to a warning. What I could not confirm: whether any harness pass actually injects the eager/lazy catalog link (the harness mounts pickers standalone, not SlidesView/DocsView, so those families may currently render as deterministic fallbacks). Fix belongs on the new code: either include the families a baseline paints in the floor, or fail when a *painted* non-floor family is still loading.

samples.summary: The refetch path removes per-family/bootstrap Google Fonts <link> elements, dropping their @font-face rules, while FontRegistry caches families as 'loaded' and will never re-request them
samples.evidence: `refetchPass` selects *every* stylesheet link whose href starts with https://fonts.googleapis.com/ and detaches/re-attaches it (verify-visual-browser.mjs:505-516) — that includes the app's own bootstrap link (font-catalog.ts:174-184) and any per-family link injected by `ensureFontLink` (font-catalog.ts:151-163). Detaching a stylesheet unregisters its @font-face rules, but `FontRegistry.ensureFont` short-circuits on a cached status (`if (current === 'loaded' || current === 'loading') return;`, packages/docs/src/view/fonts.ts:296-297), so canvas-rendered docs/slides text whose family was dropped is never re-loaded and can paint fallback glyphs in the very capture the refetch was meant to repair — and after the refetch only the three floor families are verified. Note this hazard also existed in the pre-delta href-mutation form; the delta keeps the app-owned links inside the blast radius. Fix: scope the refetch to index.html's own stylesheet link (the only one the floor depends on).

samples.summary: New "nothing to refetch" early return does not set `webFontRefetchExhausted`, bypassing the module-level invariant that one exhausted pass disables retrying for the ~24 remaining passes
samples.evidence: The flag is documented at verify-visual-browser.mjs:392-397 as "once one pass has burned through every refetch … Later passes still do their single bounded settle", and is set only on the `attempt >= maxAttempts` branch (line 534). The new branch at 552-560 records a failure and returns without setting it, so every subsequent pass re-enters the full attempt loop, re-runs the 10s settle and re-evaluates `refetchPass` — harmless in cost terms only because `refetchPass` keeps returning 0, but the invariant the flag exists to hold is skipped.

samples.summary: REQUIRED_WEB_FONTS is a hand-copied duplicate of index.html's css2 query with nothing enforcing the sync the comment demands
samples.evidence: The comment at verify-visual-browser.mjs:369-373 says "Keep the two in sync", but the floor is a literal copy of packages/frontend/index.html:12 and no test, lint rule or script derives one from the other (frontend has no tsc and no test covers this script). A weight added to index.html silently leaves the gate unable to vouch for it.

verdict.reason: The refetch code is as quoted (verify-visual-browser.mjs:505-517 detaches/re-attaches every fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet link, including the app's bootstrap link at font-catalog.ts:174-184 and per-family links at font-catalog.ts:151-163), and FontRegistry.ensureFont does short-circuit on a cached status (packages/docs/src/view/fonts.ts:293-297). But the consumer relationship that gives the finding its impact does not exist in this repository: FontRegistry is never instantiated in application code (`new FontRegistry()` occurs only in packages/docs/test/view/fonts.test.ts:63; packages/docs/src/index.ts:169 only re-exports it), and its sole would-be call site is a documented no-op stub — docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:341-353 states "DocStore does not currently expose a `fonts` registry" and calls `store.fonts?.ensureFont?.(family)` through an optional chain, while DocStore (packages/docs/src/store/store.ts:11+) has no `fonts` member at all (grep for "fonts" under packages/docs/src/store returns nothing). So no 'loaded' status is ever cached for canvas-rendered docs/slides text. The actual recovery mechanism in both canvas editors is a `document.fonts` `loadingdone` listener that clears the measure cache and repaints (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:2707-2736; packages/slides/src/view/editor/editor.ts:1040-1047), with no per-family "never re-request" cache; and after each refetch the harness re-runs `loadRequired()`, explicitly `document.fonts.load()`ing every floor family/weight again (verify-visual-browser.mjs:422-435, re-invoked at :494), which re-arms `loadingdone` and the repaint. The cited fonts.ts short-circuit is therefore unreachable on the described path, so the claimed blast-radius defect (and the file said to need the fix) is not present as described.

finding.summary: Registry-derived font wait now gates the whole visual lane on KaTeX's locally-served @font-face families, which the refetch recovery and the operator diagnostic do not cover
finding.evidence: `packages/frontend/src/index.css:4` does `@import "katex/dist/katex.min.css"`, and `packages/frontend/src/main.tsx:2` imports `index.css` for every route including `/harness/visual`. KaTeX registers ~16 families (`KaTeX_AMS`, `KaTeX_Math` — italic-only faces, `KaTeX_Script`, `KaTeX_Size1..4`, `KaTeX_Fraktur`, …) into `document.fonts`. The old wait enumerated 7 Google families, so those faces were irrelevant (the old catch-all only asserted no face was `status === "loading"`, which an `error`/`unloaded` KaTeX face satisfies). `registry()` (verify-visual-browser.mjs:385-396) now enumerates *every* registered family and `pending()` (415-439) demands per-family `status === "loaded"` plus a per-weight `fonts.check()` for each. So a KaTeX family that never reaches `loaded` — an italic-only family whose `check('400 12px "KaTeX_Math"')` does not resolve, or any woff2 the Vite dev server fails to serve out of node_modules — now fails every one of the 24 passes and hard-fails the run at line 754. Neither recovery nor diagnosis reaches it: `refetchPass` (463-473) only re-points `link.href.startsWith("https://fonts.googleapis.com/")`, and the failure message at line 636 tells the operator to "Check network access to fonts.googleapis.com", which misdiagnoses a local asset failure. Fix belongs on the new code: scope the awaited registry to the families the app actually fetches over the network (or exclude same-origin/non-Google faces), or at minimum make the report name the face's src origin.

verdict.reason: The finding's core premise is not in the code. The font wait is not registry-derived: verify-visual-browser.mjs:374-378 defines a fixed allowlist REQUIRED_WEB_FONTS = [Inter, Fraunces, JetBrains Mono], and missingRequired() (437-462) iterates only `required`, so no KaTeX family is ever checked for `loaded` or passed to fonts.check(). There is no `registry()` or `pending()` function in the file (grep for `registry` yields only comment prose at 337/345/359). loadRequired() (422-435) carries an explicit comment that it deliberately does NOT force-load every registered family precisely because KaTeX's italic-only faces would never resolve. The whole-registry check that does exist, stillLoading() (466-472), is non-gating: line 490 treats it as satisfied once quietDeadline passes, and lines 528-542 return success with a warning that names KaTeX faces as expected non-blockers; a face in `error`/`unloaded` is not even counted there. Therefore webFontFailures (546/556) can only contain the three Google families, and refetchPass's fonts.googleapis.com scoping (505-517) plus the operator message (line 703, not 636) match the only failures that can be recorded. Cited line numbers also mismatch: 754 is a "Missing captured screenshot" throw, 636 is browser.newContext. The CSS import claim (src/index.css:4) is true but harmless under the allowlist gate.
